gaps.sentence: You needn't ___ worried — everything is fine.
It was ___ a good film that we saw it twice.
It was ___ dull a lecture that people walked out.
gaps.explanation: so + adjective (+a + noun) + that… — the alternative emphatic pattern.

gaps.sentence: He was ___ to resign after the scandal.
gaps.explanation: 'be forced to do' = be made to do unwillingly.

gaps.sentence: I wish I ___ told him the truth at the time.
gaps.explanation: 'wish + past perfect' for regret about the past.

gaps.sentence: They had no ___ but to call the police.
He's got a ___ of stamps from every country he's visited.
gaps.explanation: Noun form: collection (a group of collected items).
